# Version 4.150.6
> **Ganesh failure handling** · Released October 28, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.6) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.6/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.6 improves Ganesh failure handling under GPU memory pressure.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU upload and flush failures** — Propagates checked buffer-upload failures instead of drawing stale contents, rejects incomplete helper buffers and guards failed mipmap allocation. Ganesh also tracks render-task execution separately from success so failed work is not reported as successful. ([#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323), [#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.6

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
